review_metadata.purpose: Use PR124 readability and PR125 local-private adequacy evidence to choose the next phase without implementing runtime integration.

evidence_inputs.finding: Plain-language surface is good enough for local-private adequacy comparison; source depth is now the main blocker.
One launch-beta local-private shadow review completed and did not undermine the brief story, but it remains adequate with missing private nuance.
Three checked-in-safe cases showed a consistent action-consequence signal across distinct decision families.

readiness_assessment.why_more_cases_help: More checked-in-safe cases may test breadth, but they do not answer whether private context reliably preserves or changes the brief story.
readiness_assessment.why_more_local_private_checks_help: A second or third local-private adequacy check can test whether the checked-in-safe brief consistently holds up against richer context before broadening or planning attachment.

decision_options.reason_not_selected: Readability is good enough, but source-depth risk remains the load-bearing blocker after only one local-private check.

decision_options.reason_selected: This directly tests the remaining blocker without adding runtime integration or broader checked-in-safe volume.

decision_options.reason_not_selected: Runtime attachment planning is premature until more than one local-private comparison shows the brief does not mislead.
PR124 found the plain-language surface good enough for the next adequacy gate.
Human review is still required later, but the source-depth question has a concrete next local-only check.
The launch-beta local-private check did not show the brief shape becoming misleading.

selected_next_step.rationale: The brief is readable and one local-private comparison did not undermine it, but one case is not enough to bound source-depth and overclaim risk before expansion or runtime attachment planning.

rationale.strongest_useful_signal: Across three rendered examples, the brief consistently names what action would change; in the launch-beta local-private check, that action consequence still held.
rationale.strongest_source_depth_risk: Only one case has been compared against richer local-private context, and even that case still leaves buyer reality, public-launch value, and lost-value nuance unsettled.
rationale.strongest_overclaim_risk: Readable prose plus one supporting local-private check can feel like product readiness even though there is no human validation or broad adequacy evidence.
rationale.why_runtime_integration_is_premature: The lane remains offline, Codex-assisted, non-human-validated, and source-depth-limited. Runtime attachment would make the artifact look more official than the evidence supports.
rationale.recommended_next_pr: PR127 Decision Work Brief Additional Local-Private Adequacy Checks v0

explicit_non_decisions: no lolla runtime changes were made
no provider or model calls were added
no five-case checked-in-safe batch is implemented
